svg.aria-label: The ConvFinQA eval loop as a ring: a committed split manifest of 100 train and 100 gate reports feeds a run, every LLM call is traced to MLflow, turns are scored against gold with a per-agent panel, a teacher on Claude Opus 5 through the Agent SDK blames one agent for each report's first wrong turn, a challenger that rewrites only that agent's prompt is proposed and registered as a composition of four prompt lineages, a gate on the unseen split promotes only when the change is net positive and a one-sided cluster-corrected McNemar test is significant, a sealed holdout is reserved for a confirmatory run, CI deploys and a smoke test asserts the served bundle is the champion, production traces are kept by source, and the promoted challenger becomes the next experiment's baseline; a campaign is up to five experiments against one fixed gate split. Off the ring sit the single LLM choke point and the human checks.

g.title: 01 · split manifest — evalloop/splits.py writes evaluation/splits/eval_loop_v2.json: train 100 reports (368 questions) and a fixed gate split of 100 reports (349 questions), seed 2026, stratified on Type II, drawn from the 2,777 train conversations minus the 260 that GEPA and s7 saw; the holdout is the untouched remainder of the pool, cut only for a confirmatory run; the committed id lists, not the seed, are the truth

02 · run — evalloop/runner.py: one split × one version = one MLflow run; every turn of a report is answered with the agent's own earlier answers as history, so a wrong turn poisons the turns below it exactly as in production; four pydantic-ai agents on deepseek-v4-flash, or one Claude session with --runtime agent_sdk

03 · trace — tracking/tracing.py: mlflow.pydantic_ai.autolog records every pipeline agent invocation as spans, run → report → question → agent stage → Agent.run, stamped with version, split and run name; Agent SDK calls are a CLI subprocess and get their spans opened by hand in evalloop/sdk.py

04 · score — evaluation/metrics.py and evalloop/stage_scores.py: numeric match and program match per turn, a cascade flag, and a per-agent panel derived from the gold program with zero API calls (triage turn type, preprocess skeleton and plan, retriever operand recall, calculator execution)

05 · teacher — evalloop/teacher.py on claude-opus-5 through the Claude Agent SDK, with setting_sources=[] so it inherits none of the repo's instructions: reads each report's first wrong turn with all four stage captures and the gold program, files it under a frozen failure taxonomy, blames exactly one agent, flags gold_suspect; 440 diagnoses on the ledger

06 · propose — the prompt-writer rewrites exactly one agent's prompt in tagged areas and writes a generated module; the other three prompts are imported unchanged, so every champion move has a named cause; a target agent rotates off after two consecutive rejections; 13 rewrites on the ledger

07 · register — tracking/registry.py and prompt_ledger.py: a bundle is a composition of four per-agent prompt hashes (v8 is t2.p2.r5.c2) plus both model ids, the dataset hash and the code SHA; prompts mirror into MLflow's prompt registry; the sdk_v* lineage is registered the same way under its own alias; specs are never deleted

08 · gate — tracking/comparator.py::promotable_significant and evalloop/gate.py, on the fixed unseen gate split only: net positive on the shared questions AND one-sided McNemar p below 0.05, cluster-corrected by conversation because a wrong turn poisons the turns below it; a cluster-bootstrap 95% CI and the exact p are written on every verdict; --promote is refused on train-split evidence; 9 verdicts on the ledger, 2 promotions

09 · release — evalloop/release.py: the holdout opens once, for the current champion only, behind an explicit acknowledgement flag; every opening is appended to the registry history so no later version can claim it as unseen; opened 0 times so far, mechanism tested with stubs

10 · deploy — the offline eval-regression gate re-scores the champion from its own committed CSV on every PR; merge to main deploys by GitHub OIDC to ECR and App Runner, Terraform reconciles, and demo_smoke.sh asserts the served bundle equals the registry champion — v8 at code 5af229e today

11 · observe — tracking/traces.py and serving/routes/metrics.py: one row per turn in SQLite, split by serving / demo / eval and never blended; serving opts into MLflow spans with MLFLOW_TRACING=1; the promoted challenger is the next experiment's baseline, and a campaign is up to five experiments against the same gate split

llm.py — the single LLM choke point: deepseek-v4-flash for the four agents on every turn, claude-opus-5 through the Agent SDK for the teacher and prompt-writer, claude-sonnet-5 for the single-session runtime; retry, the 120 s ceiling and the demo gate live here and nowhere else, so the keyless demo container can run neither a turn nor a cycle

the human checks — evalloop/kappa.py: a 30-case labelling sheet measures teacher-vs-human agreement on which agent failed (bar κ ≥ 0.7; the sheet is committed and not yet labelled); the gold_suspect rows the teacher flags are settled at /admin/dataset

the ring: a campaign is up to five experiments against one fixed gate split; the promoted challenger becomes the next experiment's baseline, and a refused challenger keeps its bundle, its runs and its verdict on the ledger
